conclusions.text: All 16 exact issue subjects map to original members in the pinned IND ADM3 simplified 2018, IND ADM2 2021, and PAK ADM2 2019 sources.

At pinned Atlas baseline c603befd3aaf4da90d59b12378e1e0739331efba, the two complete fragments have 0 original-source positive-length contacts and 18 selected-current-feature contacts; the combined fragment measurement is 2362541936.078026 m2.
The measured source/current boundary difference does not isolate the contribution from source simplification, tier/year differences, or Atlas reconciliation.
Natural Earth provides incomplete, modern major-lake context. WorldCover 2021 labels are sampled as a limited land-cover proxy; local surface status and disputed affiliation remain unverified.

On fresh main baseline fc328993bb8c0690b3b4687d193c7f0887bd5b17, all 16 current subject geometry digests still equal the previously retained current feature digests; the two complete fragments still measure 2362541936.078026 m2, contact no original geoBoundaries source features, and have 18 contacts to current Atlas features. This validates freshness of the earlier exact comparison inputs.

The 2021 WorldCover v200 classifications over the two complete fragments contain class-80 permanent-water labels in 25191/24898828 (0.1012%) and 116742/6654945 (1.7542%) pixel centers, respectively; the recorded land-cover classes are predominantly non-water. This is a limited 2021 product indicator only.

WorldCover classification error, local surface/water status and boundary/source-year uncertainty remain; no survey hydrology, administrative owner, or disputed affiliation is established. The result does not isolate source simplification, different tier/year, and Atlas reconciliation as causes.

All 16 subjects map to exactly one existing review-only region/province roster, but the selected upstream geoBoundaries feature properties contain no parent code. Atlas review rosters place the Indian subjects in Jaisalmer/Ganganagar/Bikaner and Punjab, and the Pakistan subjects in Punjab/Pakistan; this is current Atlas context, not independent upstream ADM1 hierarchy verification. Regional interiors remain unapproved.

methods.description: Restore exact native feature identities from complete pinned originals and map the 16 issue IDs via source shapeID/original_id lineage; no name/proximity fallback. Verify full source bytes, feature membership and both full-fragment identities.

methods.description: Compare exact source/current subject geometry and complete fragments. Measure polygon atoms on WGS84 ellipsoid, preserve line/point remnants and tiny positives, and report invalid-operation failures as unknown.
Generate complete deterministic source/fragment comparison and evidence ledgers from pinned bytes; rerun twice at the exact committed code SHA and compare complete output bytes and fields.
methods.units: whole-file bytes, square metres, metres, counts

methods.description: Recheck all exact source/current subject pairs and both full fragments against the fresh main baseline. Use exact source and prior geometry digests, WGS84 ellipsoidal area and WGS84 inverse geodesic contact lengths; retain unknowns and do not infer surface or affiliation.

Count ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 categorical pixels whose centers are within each exact full physical-gap fragment, from exact hash-verified original COG tiles. Class code 80 is reported separately and never promoted to survey water truth or territorial assignment.
methods.units: valid pixels, class counts and fractions

methods.description: Match the exact 16 native source members to existing review-only neighboring packet rosters and their present Atlas province/area hierarchy. Bind retrieved issue-body hashes and the fresh-main hierarchy/macro handoff. Do not treat current Atlas parent context as independent upstream ADM1 verification.
methods.software: Python 3.12.14; standard library JSON/hashlib; pinned current hierarchy and regional handoff
